info.title: Maintenance Notification Events
info.description:
A maintenance notification consists of a notification header and one or more items. The maintenance notification header data contains the information that is used to identify and manage the notification. It is valid for the whole maintenance notification. The following events are available for maintenance notification:

 * Maintenance Notification Created
 * Maintenance Notification Set To In Process
 * Maintenance Notification Completed

x-sap-shortText: Informs a remote system about completed, created, and set to in process maintenance notifications in an SAP S/4HANA system.

sap_s4_beh_maintenancenotification_v1_Ma.name: sap.s4.beh.maintenancenotification.v1.MaintenanceNotification.Completed.v1
sap_s4_beh_maintenancenotification_v1_Ma.description: This event is raised when a maintenance notification is completed.

sap_s4_beh_maintenancenotification_v1_Ma.name: sap.s4.beh.maintenancenotification.v1.MaintenanceNotification.Created.v1
sap_s4_beh_maintenancenotification_v1_Ma.description: This event is raised when a maintenance notification is created.

sap_s4_beh_maintenancenotification_v1_Ma.name: sap.s4.beh.maintenancenotification.v1.MaintenanceNotification.SetToInProcess.v1
sap_s4_beh_maintenancenotification_v1_Ma.description: This event is raised when a maintenance notification is being processed.

specversion.description: The version of the CloudEvents specification which the event uses. This enables the interpretation of the context.

type.description: Type of occurrence which has happened. Often this property is used for routing, observability, policy enforcement, etc.

subject.description: The subject of the event in the context of the event producer (identified by source).

time.description: Timestamp of when the occurrence happened. Must adhere to RFC 3339.
